scope: Read-only bounded existing artifact and local game-asset qualification; only owned report/scratch files written.

Current public Compose policy publishes loopback; this qualifies a same-host client path, not remote-host reachability. Keep interserver Compose DNS separate from human-facing advertisements.
checklist.found: Existing qualified image deployment metadata and accepted native loop establish an actual login/char/map headless route. No new engine, TCP, SQL or handoff probe was performed.

Public generated policy is new_account:no. Effective PIN policy and any account-specific challenge must be handled by the selected GUI. Enter passwords/PINs through masked on-device UI later; never chat or reports.

checklist.requirement: After prerequisites exist, separately verify rendering/resource load, correct test server selection, masked authentication/PIN, character list/selection and real map entry. No third-party patcher/server login is part of this test.
